summary: Detailed implementation plan for continuing the multi-language localization of the Bharatheeyam app. Covers 11 remaining files with Kannada text, organized into 4 phases: (1) Taranukoola night muhurta names, (2) Ashtamangala screen (largest), (3) Appointment/Dashboard/Settings, (4) About/Privacy screens. Includes open questions about ashtamangala priority, privacy policy prose, and numeral handling.
